title: Pastors' biggest AI worry is accuracy, not theology
subtitle: U.S. Protestant senior pastors, September 2025
caption: More than 8 in 10 pastors say AI output must be edited on the assumption that it contains errors, and that it is hard to ensure AI uses only reliable sources. A smaller majority, 55%, object that God has always shared his Word through people.
note: Question: "Which, if any, of the following concerns do you have about using AI tools for ministry. (Select all that apply)" Self-identified evangelical pastors were more likely than mainline pastors to choose the God's Word item (58% v. 51%); mainline pastors were more likely to choose plagiarism (65% v. 56%). 4% chose none of these.
